prompt:
Redesign the Vi2 account reference into ONE DESKTOP ACCOUNT DASHBOARD image only, landscape website UI, no mobile screenshot, device frame or comparison board. Reference 1 supplies Vi2's exact logo, storefront chrome, type and palette. Reference 2 is the user's iHerb example: borrow ONLY its information architecture and calm grouping, not its green branding, tiny fonts, personal data or unsupported features.

Keep Vi2 Ink #11110f, Warm Paper #f5f2ed, Cream #eee6db, neutral Stone #5e5a55; Bebas Neue for MY ACCOUNT, Inter for all interface content. Use the existing desktop search/account/cart header and current category navigation. No new fonts, colors, gradients, decorative effects or giant greeting hero.

The dashboard is a LAUNCHPAD, not a page containing all forms and order history. Left sidebar has a small My account heading, then Dashboard selected, My orders, Account information, Vi2 Points, and a separated Sign out. Main area starts a discreet breadcrumb and MY ACCOUNT. A calm top identity row contains a simple neutral initials circle 'S', 'Welcome back, Seif' and a small Edit account information link. To its right, ONE compact warm-cream rewards summary: Vi2 Points, 'Rewards are not available yet.' No imaginary balance, customer dates, referral code, earning percentage or redemption action.

After generous spacing, show THREE distinct functional navigation tiles in one row, each with a restrained existing-style line icon, heading, one short explanation and arrow: My orders — View your recent and previous orders; Account information — Manage your name, email and password; Vi2 Points — View your rewards when available. These are clickable destinations, not forms or nested dashboards. No open name/email inputs, order receipt cards, repeated profile summary, recommendations, health goals or trust claims. Comfortable outer margins, 16px body, 14px UI labels, 24px gaps and broad whitespace. Finish with Vi2's familiar restrained black footer below the dashboard.
sampleContent: No real customer contact, reward code, balance or dates reproduced
reference: User-supplied iHerb desktop screenshots for structure; existing Vi2 artwork/tokens for identity
